hdf5.description: HDF5 C and C++ libraries for builds configured with -DWITH_HDF5=ON.

eol-bspline.description: Use external eol-bspline library instead of vendored version via -DUSE_EXTERNAL_EOLBSPLINE=ON.

isospec.description: Use external IsoSpec library instead of vendored version via -DUSE_EXTERNAL_ISOSPEC=ON.

sqlitecpp.description: Use external SQLiteCpp library instead of vendored version via -DUSE_EXTERNAL_SQLITECPP=ON.

nlohmann-json.description: Use external nlohmann-json library instead of vendored version via -DUSE_EXTERNAL_JSON=ON.

simde.description: Use external SIMDe library instead of vendored version via -DUSE_EXTERNAL_SIMDE=ON.

wnetalign.description: Enable the Wasserstein network alignment feature (FeatureLinkerWNet TOPP tool) via -DWITH_WNETALIGN=ON. When enabled, the three header-only libraries pylmcf, wnet, and wnetalign are installed

onnxruntime.description: Enables ONNX Runtime support for machine-learning based inference modules via -DWITH_ONNX=ON.

opentims.description: Enables support for reading Bruker TimsTOF .d directories directly (without prior conversion to mzML) via the opentims library with -DWITH_OPENTIMS=ON.

openms-thermo-bridge.description: Enable native reading of Thermo Fisher RAW files via the openms-thermo-bridge C++/.NET library via -DWITH_THERMO_RAW=ON.

lp-glpk.description: Select glpk as linear programming solver backend via -DLP_SOLVER=GLPK.

lp-highs.description: Select highs as linear programming solver backend via -DLP_SOLVER=HIGHS.
